verdict.rationale: The only openness evidence is a community remark that LaunchDarkly's Relay Proxy (a small first-party Go component run on your own infrastructure) is open source; nothing shows the core LaunchDarkly platform's source is published or which license applies. missing for 10: open-source availability of the core service, a named open license, first-party documentation of source repositories, and coverage of SDKs/CLI/MCP server source.
